ACTIVE_CURRENT.description: Device can report electric current consumption in amperes

ACTIVE_POWER.description: Device can report current power consumption

attributes.description: List of supported operating capability profiles for this aircon model. Use these profiles to constrain the values offered for state.mode, state.fan, state.hswing, and state.targetTemp instead of assuming that every aircon supports every option. Most devices return a single profile, but the field is a list. See AirpatrolCapability below.

ALERT.description: Device supports indicating some form of alert

ANALOG_VALUE.description: Device represents an analog value. E.g. temperature set point as Bacnet analog value

BATTERY_C.description: Device can monitor own battery charging

BATTERY_U.description: Device can monitor own battery voltage

CLEAR_ALERT.description: Device can clear alert e.g. alert is not canceled automatically by the device (or stuck)

CO2.description: Capability to detect CO2 concentration levels

COLOR_HS.description: Device uses Hue and Saturation for handling color

COLOR_RGB.description: [NOT INUSE?] Device uses RGB for handling color

COLOR_XY.description: [NOT INUSE?] Device uses X/Y for handling color

attributes.path: Get and set via hub command api .../devices/configuration

CONFIGURABLE.description: This capability means that there is device specific configuration dict available

attributes.description: How much of the maximum heating power is in use

DETERIORATION.description: Capability for detecting deterioration in person's condition, healthcare, e.g. watch

attributes.description: All devices have this boolean flagg indicating wether the device is currently connected with the gateway device (like the Hub). Accuracy of the information depends on the protocol, e.g. a 433 switch is always reported as reachable because there is no way of telling if the device can hear commands or not. On the other hand if a USB speaker is removed from the Hub, that is detected immediately and reachable flagg is updated near real time.

DEVICE.description: Any device, used as an marker

DEVICE_HEALTH.description: Capability for reporting device health. E.g. reset/button stuck

DIMMER.description: Device controls dim level, a bit like remote control but might have no buttons

EXT_THERMOMETER.description: Capability meaning that the device needs an external temperature meter

FLOW.description: Capability to measure flow l/hour (e.g. water flow by water meter)

FLOW_TEMPERATURE.description: Capability to measure flow temperature degrees Celsius (e.g. water temperature by water meter)

attributes.description: Calculated daily volume using the Hub time zone.
Calculated previous-day volume using the Hub time zone.
Marks the meter as hot-water capable. Set through DeviceMetaCommand.

FLOW_VOLUME.description: Capability to measure flow volume l (e.g. total water consumption by water meter)

attributes.description: Unique identification that allows to be tracked
Possible message text attached to triggered alarm
Device specific code for alarm details

G_NOTIFICATION.description: Device can report device specific notifications. List of strings. String contains timestamp and notification identifier, e.g. ["1723805449000:NOTIF_1_ID"]

HOME_SWITCH.description: Home switch mode. Used for remote controls/wallswitches which can be used as Home/Away switch E.g. with Aeotec wallmote quad device setting homeSwitchMode to True will control one scene with first and second buttons and another scene with 3rd and 4th buttons instead of controlling one scene / button Mode is available as boolean value in device attribute homeSwitchMode and can be changed with Device meta command attribute homeSwitchMod

KNX_AWAY_SWITCH.description: KNX Home/Away switch, via e.g. mqtt

attributes.description: Unitless adaptive NOx index. The base value is 1; values above 1 indicate more nitrogen oxides in the air than usual.

NOX.description: Capability to report nitrogen oxides air-quality index

ON_OFF.description: Device can be turned on / off

PASSIVITY.description: Capability for detecting passivity of a person, healthcare, e.g. watch

attributes.description: List index 0 contains current for phase 1, index 1 for phase 2, and index 2 for phase 3.

PHASE_I.description: List of electrical current on individual phases

attributes.description: List index 0 contains power for phase 1, index 1 for phase 2, and index 2 for phase 3.

PHASE_P.description: List of electricity power on individual phases

attributes.description: List index 0 contains voltage for phase 1, index 1 for phase 2, and index 2 for phase 3.

PHASE_U.description: List of electrical voltage on individual phases

PHONE_MAKE_CALL.description: The device can make a phone calls

PHONE_RECEIVE_CALL.description: The device can answer phone calls. When answering the current callState is RINGING and the given callState should be IN_CALL

PLAY_MUTE.description: Speaker device play mute, true means muted and false means not muted

attributes.description: Write only, tone is not reported back in state.

PLAY_TONE.description: Write-only tone trigger for speaker devices

attributes.description: PM2.5 means particulate matter with diameter less than 2.5 micrometers.

PM25.description: Capability to report PM2.5 fine particulate matter concentration

attributes.description: Timestamp for when the power save changed.

POWER_SAVE.description: Device can operate in a device specific powersave mode: NORMAL = 0  # Normal operation mode, power cord connected, PENDING = 1  # Power cord disconnected, pending power save, IN_EFFECT = 2  # Power save in effect, TEMPORARILY_OFF = 3  # Power save is in effect, but we are doing periodic connection

attributes.description: Timestamp for when the power source changed.

POWER_SOURCE.description: Device can report which power source it is using. SOURCE_MAINS = Mains power, SOURCE_BATTERY = Battery power

PROXIMITY.description: Capability to detect the proximity of the device i.e. is it close to hub or not.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION.description: Device can receive push notifications from push notification center in internet

RAW_MESSAGE.description: The original native datagram received from the device

RC_DIMMER.description: Functional capability allowing the remote control to be selected for a dimmer rule

REC_MUTE.description: Speaker device record mute, true means muted and false means not muted

REC_VOLUME.description: Speaker device record volume (speaker has microphone)

ROAMING.description: Capability for indicating that the device is a roaming device which may be automatically paired to multiple hubs.

RSSI.description: Capability to report RSSI of received message.

attributes.description: Timestamp for when the setpoint was set
Schedule for setpoints to use. List of tuples where first item is starttime for setpoint and second item is the setpoint in effect after the starttime.
For example, a room setpoint may drive both floor heating and air conditioning through rules.
Timestamp for when the setpoint temperature was last updated.

SETPOINT_TEMPERATURE.description: Virtual device containing a temperature setpoint value. This can be used for setting a single generic setpoint which is then used for controlling multiple physical devices by rules.

attributes.description: Current motor direction.
Indicates that calibration is running.

SIGNAL.description: Device can give signal. E.g. Bacnet binary value

STARTUP_VALS.description: Device can restore previous settings after power cycle

values.2: describing the state of the device.

TILT.description: Device can control the angle of curtain

TRANSITION.description: Device can use transition time between state changes

attributes.description: Upgrade availability and progress state. Detailed upgrade metadata can be read through the device-specific upgrade-info response, which includes fields such as fwVersion, swVersion, newFwVersion, newSwVersion, lastUpgrade, autoInstall, pctComplete, and etaMs.
User id of the last user who logged into this ui and used this hub. Read-only.

True if the ui device is currently connected this Hub otherwise False. Connected means that the Cozify app is running and using this Hub. It takes about 10-20 seconds for the hub to detect that the app was closed. Read-only.

VALVE.description: Percentage value telling how open a valve should be

VOC.description: Capability to detect Volatile Organic Compound

VOICE_CALL.description: The device can perform audio calls (cellular, voip etc.)

VOICE_CALL_AUTOANSWER.description: The device can be configured to automatically answer calls for a period of time. If a list of allowed telephone numbers is given, the call will be automatically answered only if it comes from such a number.

attributes.description: Unitless adaptive VOC index. The index average is 100; values below 100 indicate improving air quality and values above 100 indicate worsening air quality.

VOX.description: Capability to report volatile organic compounds air-quality index

VU_FN_FIREPLACE.description: Ventilation Unit Fireplace function, increases indoor air pressure when there is fire burning in the fireplace

WEARABLE.description: Capability for indicating that the device is worn, e.g. a watch

changelog.summary: Documented the `DEVICE_LIST` and `SCENE` configuration item field types.
Documented the end-to-end flow for claiming a factory-new Hub on the local network with an example sequence.
Documented `GET_MODBUS_TCP_CONFIG` and the `MODBUS_TCP_CONFIG` response object. Restructured Z-Wave operations into per-message reference sections.
Documented raw history datapoint retrieval by omitting `interval`.
Documented remote-access `402 Payment Required` and obsolete API version `410 Gone` responses.
